svg.title: Through the goalie in a stick save, NHL '94 and NHL '95
svg.text: Through the goalie in a stick save: NHL '94 against NHL '95
A flat puck sent at a computer goalie who has just started a stick save, in 17 lanes across his middle, at six speeds.
NHL '94: 15 of 204 in (7%), all but one after he touched it. NHL '95: 34 of 408 in (8%), 32 of them untouched.
In after a touch: the puck crosses the stick's blind ring and his body bounces it back into the net.
lane: units across from his centre
In untouched: the puck slides down a channel through his middle to the goal line.
lane: units across from his centre
a goal the goalie never touched
Both games stop every puck outside their middle lanes. A person's goalie wasn't tested.
